title: Deploy ci-platform and repin owned-ci so gate evidence keeps failing TAP lines
body:
Outcome: the deployed CI keeps failing TAP lines. The fix for t-xqp3agn (summaryStream failure reserve, evidence summary 'Failing TAP lines') lives in infra/ci Go code; the executor VM runs the installed /usr/local/libexec/ci-platform and Jenkins loads owned-ci at a pinned library_sha, so a merge changes nothing until deployment (infra/ci/jenkins/diagnostics-and-queue.md steps 1-4: drain, build+sha256, stage on VM109 and VM108, reseal VM108 snapshot, repin library_sha).
Grant boundary: installing binaries and resealing the CI snapshot is production work (infra/ci/README.md 'Deployment boundary'); needs the deployment owner's recorded grant. Batch with the t-33mv33n library repin.
Proof: a red krn/gate on a PR with >256 KiB stdout shows a 'not ok' line in its check-run summary.

Also install Go 1.27.3 (infra/ci/mise.toml pin) in the gate guest image so test/ci/gate-evidence-failures.test.ts runs its Go receivers in krn/gate instead of passing with a diagnostic (CI strict evidence rejects skips; decision 2026-11-05 in .krn/runs/lead/decisions.md).
